including a face in video instruction improves learners' affect and perceived educational value of instruction, but does not improve short-term information retention.
including the face of an instructor in video instruction is preferred by learners and leads to a more positive affective response, but does not significantly improve short- or medium-term recall.
adding an overlay of the instructor's face increases learners' positive affect and perceived educational value, but does not affect information retention.

the design of video instruction and its impact on learning.

the face in the video is not the best way to deliver the information, but it is an effective way to make people feel more comfortable and satisfied.
